items: [For Small Spaces] Standing at 11.8"D x 13.4"W x 22.8"H, this end table takes up little floor space while serving as a catchall with 3 storage tiers—stage a chamomile cup on the top, a basket on the bottom, and your tablet in the middle

[Streamlined yet Stunning] Giving an industrial look to any space, from the living room to bedroom, this side table has a clean, understated design while making an impressive statement with its rustic brown tone and matte black steel accent

[Well-Built and Well-Balanced] With particleboard braced by steel side frames, this table is solid and stable, capable of holding 44 lb of items on each tier. Adjustable feet preventing wobbling on uneven floors is an extra factor for its stability

[Simple yet Smooth] Was assembling a piece of furniture in the past nerve-wracking? Not this time. With clear instructions and numbered parts, the assembly will be completed in 4 simple steps, going like clockwork
[What You Receive] An end table brimming with an industrial-inspired style, with 3 open tiers for ready-at-hand storage, working as either an occasional table or a nightstand
